abstractEnglish: We prove the conjecture that the irrationality exponent of π is 2. As a consequence, the classical Flint–Hills series $`\sum_{n\ge1}1/(n^3\sin^2 n)`$ converges, with angles in radians.
titleEn: The irrationality exponent of pi is 2
